summary: Pickens County, AL tower completed 1948 by the Alabama Forestry Commission (100' Aermotor MC-39); NHLR-registered 2011; current condition not described in sources read.

facts.design: 100' Aermotor MC-39 with 7'x7' cab; a 1955 survey describes a four-legged steel structure with an enclosed top platform

events.note: Completed in 1948 as the third lookout in Pickens County (NHLR)
Registered January 3, 2011 as US 896, AL 54; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

evidence.quote: When completed in 1948, Carrollton Fire Tower became the third lookout in Pickens County.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, and neither describes the tower's condition after the 2011 registration, so the record's 'standing' status and 'unknown' access are unconfirmed. No staffing, fire or fate information was found; one web search added nothing new. NHLR elevation 402 ft (123 m) matches the record.
